findings.text: The same `Recite.on_trace ??= …` one-liner, with a long regex, is pasted twice (ext/drawer/Sheet.js:53 and ux/Dictate/chat.js:80), and the two regexes differ (only Sheet's has `sheet`). Because of `??=` the first to run wins (the Sheet, built first), so chat.js's copy is dead whenever a Sheet exists. Make one function, for example `Recite.log_to_session` next to `trace()` in audio/Recite/Recite.js, and call it from both.

The new behaviour is undocumented in the modules the diff touches. audio/Recite/readme.md:45 still says each step goes only to the Whisper log. It does not mention `Recite.on_trace`, the session-file `log` line, the new `unlocked` field, or that the Sheet now feeds Recite. ext/drawer/readme.md:35 and ext/drawer/doc/sheet.md have nothing on `read_aloud()`. ext/Chat/v2/readme.md has nothing on `report.diag`. CLAUDE.md law 9 says to fix the readme in the same task.

The task folder cannot stand alone. It holds only requirements.md and review/diff.patch. The "Proven headless" claim has no run record, shot, probe script or session-file excerpt behind it, so a fresh agent cannot verify it or rerun it. Add the probe and its result, or a link to one.

ext/drawer/Sheet.js:51-67 opens a second `Wire.stream` on the same session that chat.js:301 already follows. Both feed `Recite.shared.from_wire`, whose `done` and `live` state absorbs the duplicate. Reading is correct, but each page now holds two EventSources per session. Dropping chat.js's `from_wire` call (chat.js:246, 304) in favour of the Sheet's would give one reader, per law 6, but is only safe if every page that mounts chat also has a Sheet.

The Sheet's follower has none of chat.js's `watching_since` guard. It relies only on `from_wire`'s 120 s age check (Recite.js:174), so a reply under two minutes old that arrives on attach can be read aloud on every page load.

`read_aloud()` calls `report.init(first)` itself at Sheet.js:55 and 62. chat.js does the same at line 295. Sheet.js:62 re-inits on every session switch, and the diff does not show whether `init` is idempotent. Please confirm.

answer.reply: fixed: chat.js's copy is gone; the Sheet owns Recite.on_trace
fixed: Recite readme says who starts it (Sheet.read_aloud) and that its steps also land in the session file (on_trace, report.diag); the drawer readme names read_aloud
fixed: probe.mjs and probe-output.txt in this folder, with the first run's play-ok lines
noted: two streams on one session for now; chat.js's reading hook can go once the Sheet's proves itself on the phone
noted: Recite's own 2-minute age check and its done-set stand in for watching_since
noted: report.init only sets the session after the first call (the listeners are installed once), so a second call is safe
